validation.transcendental_scope: 9216 padded test values; nearest float neighbors at range-reduction/underflow boundaries, signed zero, tiny inputs, extreme gates to +/-1e30 and 8192 seeded random gates. Scalar/vector output bits must match; FP64 oracle uses original stage tolerance 2e-5 + 2e-5*abs(reference).
validation.build: Full release-int8-ffn-kernels preset succeeded; fresh default artifacts dispatched and checked
validation.scope: Exact same-precision 128-token snapshots, 1116 vectors including all 960 first-token nodes, logits/state checkpoints, reset/branch, rejected invalid inputs and host state API. No numerical tolerances loosened.

data.scope: Marked execution on selected cores; excludes waiting for initial activation. Fractions overlap; vector issue is not peak-compute utilization.

current_device_trace.scope: Same seven-lane topology with trace egress; first lane only, five complete head calls on each of three cores. Markers exclude FIFO acquire/release. Tracing can perturb execution. Lower vector-issue fraction reflects fewer issued instructions and is not a regression or a peak-FLOPS utilization measure.

profile_scope: Host-observed stage wall time includes scheduling, switching, DMA and compute; not pure kernel latency.

resources.traffic_change: No model BO, DMA layout or host traffic change in this iteration

limitations_and_next_work: Existing half precision is BF16, not IEEE FP16; that requirement remains unresolved
INT8 remains experimental FFN-only W8A16; held-out corpus and long-context production quality gates remain
Prefill measurement is still sequential resident replay; batched NPU prefill remains required
INT8 ChannelMix is now largest aggregate host-observed stage (~53.8 ms/token), followed by fused recurrence (~51.6 ms/token); profile data movement and conversion there before further tuning
Preparation still exceeds update cycles by about 5.4 times; retained FP64 statistics and scalar FP32 division need separate profiling before changes
Continue measuring actual DDR/DMA bandwidth, scheduling stalls and full-array utilization; architectural roofline not established
Four process runs per precision do not establish confidence intervals; sampled bit equality is not exhaustive proof over all FP32 inputs
